rationale: Changes the persisted caption shape by adding general and Facebook caption kinds through Postgres enum ALTERs, repurposes CAPTION_CHANNELS away from the publish list, and drops or ignores the wizard channel picker and Brief.channels, with the data-model choice left open to the plan.

signals.blast_radius: Caption data model, Channel enum and CAPTION_CHANNELS, FACT_WHERE, the caption prompt budget, the wizard channel picker, Brief.channels, the MCP get_draft and generate_post response shape, ACP manifest, analytics catalogue, Insights and the caption E2E suites, about 50 files, with structural moves rather than additive call sites.
signals.unresolved: Whether general and Facebook become new Channel values or a separate caption-kind column, and whether Brief.channels is dropped or ignored, both of which change the migrations and the file list; also whether general can be regenerated on its own.
signals.irreversibility: Postgres ALTER TYPE ADD VALUE cannot be cleanly removed, existing Instagram and LinkedIn rows are reinterpreted as curated captions, and the MCP/ACP response shape is a released contract, so undoing it is more than a git revert.
